title: Primal: The Awakening
subtitle: Tactical boss-battling campaign with deck-crafting combat and relentless prehistoric behemoths
tagline: Hunt colossal beasts, forge your deck, and survive the savage wilds of Thyrea
loreSummary: You are elite hunters stranded in the savage, untamed continent of Thyrea. In a primordial realm where humanity is prey, only synchronized positioning, forged equipment, and mastering every card combo will keep you alive against towering apex monsters.
keyFeatures: Dynamic positional combat around a multi-sector monster board
Tactical deck-crafting with color-coded attack, defense, and maneuvering combos
Persistent hunter progression, weapon forging, and settlement alchemy
Adaptive monster AI deck reacting to aggression levels and hunter positioning

primal_standard.name: Standard Hunter Campaign
primal_standard.description: Complete 11-chapter core narrative journey plus the climactic Awakened finale and key gear-farming hunts.

primal_story.name: Main Story Run (Direct Path)
primal_story.description: Direct progression through the 11 core storyline chapters straight to the Awakened confrontation.

primal_completionist.name: Apex Master & Expansions
primal_completionist.description: All branching questboard hunts, legendary trophy forging, optional side monsters, and Mount Havoc campaign.
